transcript: Speaker A: Spelling likhte waqt tukka marna band karo. English mein ing lagane ka ye simple rule seekh lo. [Stop guessing spellings. Learn this simple rule for adding -ing in English.] Jump ke peeche ing lagaya to jumping hota hai. Par run word ke peeche agar hum ing lagaye to running, yaani yahan ek hi jagah double n ho jaate hain. [Adding -ing to jump makes jumping. But adding it to run makes running, doubling the 'n'.] Kabhi socha hai aisa kyun? Chalo iska ek simple rule main aaj aapko samjhata hoon. [Ever wondered why? Let me explain a simple rule today.] Jo bhi word hai, usme hamesha peeche se letters count karo. One, two. [Always count letters from the back of the word. One, two.] Agar two number pe koi bhi vowel aaye, yaani a, e, i, o, u aaya, aur uski short sound nikal rahi hai, to rule yaad rakho: one, two, double I do. [If there is a vowel at position two with a short sound, remember the rule: one, two, double it.] Yaani aakhri letters ko double karke ing laga do. Isliye run ka running ho jayega, aur tap ka tapping. [Double the last letter and add -ing. So run becomes running, and tap becomes tapping.] Lekin agar hum jump ko peeche se count karein, one, two, three, yahan vowel teesre number par aa raha hai. [But if we count jump from the back, the vowel is at position three.] To iska rule hai: one, two, three, it's not for me. Yaani yahan double nahi karna hai, seedha ing lagana hai. [So the rule is: one, two, three, it's not for me. No doubling, just add -ing.] Isliye jump ka bana jumping, aur help ka bana helping. [So jump becomes jumping, and help becomes helping.] Lekin English ke aise hi hazaaron shortcuts, dimaag khol dene wale rules, aur daily use hone wali English aap bina ratte English Seekho app se seekh sakte ho. [You can learn thousands of such shortcuts, rules, and daily English without memorizing on the English Seekho app.] Yahan par aapko koi boring padhai nahi karni hai. Aap experts ke aise hi short, crisp aur smart videos dekhkar rozana bolne wali English, mushkil grammar ke rules, aur ekdum perfect pronunciation seekh sakte hain. [No boring studies here. Watch short, crisp videos by experts to learn spoken English, grammar rules, and perfect pronunciation.] Aur sabse mazedaar feature, app mein ek AI Coach hai, jiske saath aap bina kisi hichkichahat, sharm ya mazaak ke darr ke, din-raat English mein bolne ki practice kar sakte ho. [The best feature is the AI Coach, allowing you to practice speaking English day and night without hesitation or fear of judgment.] Wo aapki har galti ko pakad ke turant sahi karega, aur aapki English ko ekdum mast aur polish kar dega. [It will catch and correct your mistakes instantly, polishing your English.] To ab rules ka ratta marna band karo, smart tareeqe se videos dekho, aur AI Coach ke saath farratedar English bolna shuru karo. Abhi English Seekho app download karo. [Stop memorizing rules, watch smart videos, and start speaking fluent English with the AI Coach. Download the English Seekho app now.] Install button par click karo aur English Seekho app download karo. [Click the install button and download the English Seekho app.]
